issue: Tracked production profile regressed P80 cadence from FAST back to NORMAL.

root_cause.detail: Polling rebalance changed P80 together with other cadence changes, undoing the earlier latency fix.

impact: A transient GFA transport failure could leave productive GFA reads suppressed until a later successful P80 poll; NORMAL cadence increases worst-case guard recovery latency.

fix.semantics: read-only GFA P80 identity polling only; no new write path

related_guard: requests_util keeps last validated P80=0x20 across transient transport failures and revokes it only on a successful non-0x20 read.
